name: RiskMandate Conductor
one_line: The session that runs the site's team on an hourly loop since 16 November 2026, with six roles inside it; it pushes dev, and dev is the live site. Documented from the repository and the session's own record, not measured.
runs_as: Claude Code on the web, in a managed container with this repository attached and an egress proxy above it; woken every hour from 07:37 to 23:37 London by a scheduled task set outside this repository.

shape.label: Claude Code on the web, with one repository attached, running six roles
shape.note: The same shape as the publisher's, so the catalogue's template (measured on the thing itself on 5 September 2026) is the base. Nothing below was probed for this page: every row is documented from what this repository records (the git log, the briefs, the role files, the CI workflow) and from what the session reports of itself, read on 18 November 2026. Six roles run inside this one session as sub-agents (developer, designer, sherpa, synthetic users, ambassador, researcher, in .claude/agents/rm-*.md); they are not separate agents and have no ABP of their own, because each is this session's grant with a narrower tools line.

role: Picks the top item on the backlog in T18 every hour, runs at most three of its six roles on it, builds and checks the site, commits in the site's voice, pushes its branch and, since the lead's yes of 17 November, merges into dev, which deploys. Records the lead's words when they reach it, through another session or directly, and keeps a list of what waits on the lead. It drafts outward words and sends none. The roles: the developer builds pages; the designer the visual layer; the sherpa walks a visitor's path and edits nothing; the synthetic users run four personas and edit nothing; the ambassador drafts the message and posts nothing; the researcher reads the team's own public record and screenshots it.

grant.control: Prose: T18 says merge into dev only after the lead's yes, then per the merge workflow; the rules of engagement say the same. grant.note: It acts at the code host as the platform's app, never as the lead. Inside the one repository the scope bounds nothing: every branch, dev included.

not_in_grammar: Two things this session does fall outside the 23. It sends a message to another Claude session (send_message), which is how it answers the AgentiCCells conductor that relays the lead's words; the reach is sessions on the platform, not the world, so send.message.world does not fit, and the only thing in the way is prose (never contact anybody: CLAUDE.md, T18, every role file). And it starts sub-agents in its own container with the tools named in each role file; the tools line narrows a role, and it is a setting, because the conductor can edit the file.

session.how: The running session is woken every hour; a clean session on this repository starts with the prompt below and runs one turn of the loop.
session.prompt: You are the RiskMandate Conductor (conductor.riskmandate). Read, in this order: CLAUDE.md; .claude/briefs/T18-the-hourly-loop.md; docs/briefs/direction__we-can-control-your-agents.md; site/team/conductor.json. Work on claude/conductor-web-summit-2026. Run one turn of the loop as T18 says: fetch and merge dev if behind; pick the top open item; run at most three roles from .claude/agents/rm-*.md on it; generate.mjs, build-admin.mjs, npm run check green; check every changed page at 390 and 1280; commit in the site's voice; push the branch; merge into dev only per the merge workflow and only on the lead's yes; update the backlog. Never send, post or contact anybody; never create a session or a scheduled task without asking the lead; never hold a secret. End with what changed, what was not done and what needs the lead.
session.schedule: Every hour from 07:37 to 23:37 London, set from outside this repository by the AgentiCCells conductor (T18). Nobody on this team creates another.
